We're starting a brand new modpack today, and it turns out the hardest thing isn't getting all of the mods to play nicely together, it's figuring out where to build your base!
This first video has very minimal editing, don't worry, that changes next time!

Hi! I'm Skiy, and I'm playing Modded Minecraft. With a plethora of mods at my disposal in my custom modpack, Astral Skiy, I'm aiming to build a fully functional space station, and explore the far reaches of space.
